messages:
pagerbot: PagerDuty alert fired for service=inference-prod severity=pg_2 — high tail latency detected. link: https://pd/redwood/INC-4827 :rotating_light:
incident-bot: Automatic details — metric=latency.p99 env=eu-west region, affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. Auto-escalation in 5m if not acked.
eli: ack — oncall here, taking initial triage. pinging maya in case we need infra.
incident-bot: Acknowledged by eli. Escalation timer paused.
eli: quick check — p99 up to ~2.1s on edge routers, backend token generation p99 ~1.8s. No error spike (5xx) in last 10m.
maya: thanks. any customer-facing impact so far?
cs-ops: customer-reported slow responses for realtime results in europe — one enterprise trial hit timeouts on batch ingestion, roughly 15% of requests retried. logging ticket #CS-998.
eli: noted. hypothesis = KV cache thrash after short-lived workload burst. checking cache hit rates...
eli: (paste) cache_metrics: last_min_hit_rate=0.62 -> historical=0.95 ; backend queue depth for model-router-3 = 42 -> normal= <10.
jules: copying runbook: https://confluence/redwood/runbooks/inference-latency. Suggest checking router JVM GC, model-worker GPU saturation, and prefix cache evictions.
tia: pagerbot shows a small coordinated deploy ~12m ago in eu-west tagged "model-quant-2026-03" — could be related.
eli: rolling logs from router-3: ```[2026-03-14T09:12:03Z] WARN queue-length=41 route=/v1/chat worker=router-3
[2026-03-14T09:12:08Z] INFO cached-prefix-evict key=usr:prefix:27 size=412
[2026-03-14T09:12:09Z] INFO worker-gpu-util=98%```
oncall-sre: hmm gpu at 98% is suspicious. can we scale pool or divert some traffic?
eli: trying quick mitigation — bumping router pool min from 4 -> 8 for eu-west. running: ```kubectl -n inference scale deployment/router-eu-west --replicas=8```
opsbot: Scaling initiated for deployment/router-eu-west -> target replicas=8. Pods creating: router-eu-west-8a, router-eu-west-8b
maya: I'll take over if eli needs to step out in ~10. can you capture the handoff with context?
eli: handing off to maya — captured: cause suspected = cache eviction + recent model quant deploy; immediate mitigation = scale routers, monitor cache hit, consider rolling restart of quantized model workers if GPU saturation persists.
maya: ack and got context. starting traffic-shift plan: divert 15% of eu-west inference traffic to eu-north as a precaution. using weight route: ```curl -X POST https://routing.internal/set-weights -d '{"eu-west":0.85,"eu-north":0.15}'```
jules: reminder — update customer comms if impact continues >30m.
cs-ops: on it, prepping a short note for affected customers — ETA 10m.
incident-bot: Traffic shift executed, weights updated. New observed p99 for eu-west dropped from 2.1s -> 1.05s over 90s. eu-north p99 increased by 0.2s but within SLO.
maya: good signal. checking worker pools — model-worker-quantized still at ~96% GPU on two nodes. scheduling a gentle rolling restart of quantized workers to flush bad allocations: ```for pod in $(kubectl -n inference get pods -l role=model-quant -o name); do kubectl -n inference delete $pod; sleep 10; done```
tia: keep an eye on warmup token latency after restart, might see small spike for cold cache.
eli: logs show cache hit rate improving to 0.87 post-scale. queues down to 8.
oncall-sre: nice. any persistent 5xxs or customer errors?
cs-ops: so far retries are diminishing, no new 5xx. customer message drafted, will send after you confirm stabilization.
maya: hold on comms until we see stable p99 < 1.2s for next 5m. we should also create a follow-up to investigate deploy rollback if root cause confirmed.
eli: agree. i'll collect flamegraphs and KV eviction traces into the incident folder.
opsbot: Rolling restart of model-quant pods completed — 3 pods restarted sequentially.
incident-bot: Alert auto-clear scheduled when metric latency.p99 falls below threshold for 10m.
maya: p99 currently 0.98s eu-west, queue depth ~4, GPU util 65% on quant nodes. marking as stable.
jules: recommend post-incident action: add a canary delay after future quantized model deploys and add cache-warm path in rollout.
cs-ops: sending customer note now: "We've mitigated the latency spike; traffic was shifted and nodes scaled. We're continuing monitoring and will follow up with details."
eli: handing final control back to maya for postmortem. thanks team.
maya: Thanks all — closing incident in 10m if no regression. assigning follow-up jira INF-1210 for root cause and rollout safety.
incident-bot: Incident marked resolved by maya — resolved at 2298765660. Postmortem owner: maya.
pagerbot: PagerDuty INC-4827 status=resolved.
maya: quick retrospective notes: short mitigation effective, root cause likely interaction between recent quant deploy + cache eviction; follow-ups: canary gating, cache warmers, autoscale policy tweak. I'll file details in postmortem. :white_check_mark:
